expectations.text: Writes a validation report at docs/validation/002-due-dates.md following the report template.
expectations.evidence: Report present with Summary, Open findings, Coverage, Regression, Not verified, Observations, Closed findings.

expectations.text: Reports the business-rule boundary defect: a task due today is marked overdue (S6.2 / R4).
expectations.evidence: F1 in both runs, with the <= comparison in src/dates.js named.

expectations.text: Reports the UI defect: title and marking are 14 px on a phone instead of the required 20 px (QE5).
expectations.evidence: with_skill F4 measured with getComputedStyle at 390x844; baseline F4 measured at 375x812.

expectations.text: Reports that recurring tasks were built although 002 lists them as out of scope.
expectations.evidence: F3 in both runs: repeat field, 'Repeat weekly' checkbox, stored value.

expectations.text: Reports the 001 regression: done tasks no longer sorted below open ones (001 S3.2).
expectations.evidence: F2 in both runs; the 001 acceptance suite fails 1 of 11.

expectations.text: Finds all four planted defects.
expectations.evidence: 4 of 4 in both runs.

expectations.text: Raises no more than one finding outside the planted set.
expectations.evidence: One extra in each run: QE7, the add form wrapping on a phone, which is a direct consequence of the out-of-scope checkbox and is legitimate.

expectations.text: Derives the checks from the requirements instead of mirroring the implementation report's claims.
expectations.evidence: Both runs explicitly contradict the report's 'all passed' self-validation.

expectations.text: Adds black-box acceptance tests under tests/acceptance/002-due-dates/.
expectations.evidence: Present in both runs.

expectations.text: Actually starts the compose stack and reports evidence from the running product.
expectations.evidence: Both ran the stack, measured memory and latency, and tore it down.

expectations.text: Runs the 001 acceptance tests as a regression and reports the result.
expectations.evidence: with_skill 10/11; baseline 001 10 passed 1 failed, 002 13 passed 5 failed.

expectations.text: Every finding has numbered steps to reproduce, an Expected, an Actual and a severity.
expectations.evidence: with_skill: 5 findings, each with numbered steps, Severity, Expected, Actual. Baseline: prose findings with code excerpts and failing test names, but no numbered steps and no Severity/Expected/Actual fields (0 matches).

expectations.text: Changes no product code.
expectations.evidence: git diff against the seed tip over src/, public/, Dockerfile, compose and package.json is empty in both runs.

expectations.text: Sets the requirements status to 'Changes requested – back to implementation' and gives that verdict.
expectations.evidence: with_skill: status set, verdict 'Changes requested'. Baseline: status left at 'Implemented – ready for validation', verdict written as 'Rejected – findings to fix', which is not one of the defined verdicts.

expectations.text: Asks the user no question in its final message.
expectations.evidence: Neither run asks anything.

expectations.text: Writes a validation report at docs/validation/002-find-a-task.md following the report template.
expectations.evidence: Present in both runs.

expectations.text: Reports that the search is prefix-only and case-sensitive, quoting S5.2, S5.3 or R4.
expectations.evidence: F1 in both runs, with the stakeholder's own 'milk' example reproduced.

expectations.text: Classifies that finding as a design problem and does not blame the implementer.
expectations.evidence: Both name docs/architecture/002-find-a-task.md as the cause and route it to the architect.

expectations.text: Writes a gap file at docs/architecture/.gaps/002-find-a-task.md in the implementer's gap format.
expectations.evidence: with_skill: G1 with Status, Design, Requirement, Problem, Blocks, Suggestion. Baseline: no .gaps file exists.

expectations.text: Runs a real load test with 10 concurrent users against the stack with about 500 tasks.
expectations.evidence: with_skill: 500 tasks, 10 concurrent searchers. Baseline: 500 tasks, 10 concurrent searchers, 2000 searches.

expectations.text: Reports a measured p95 latency and compares it with the 500 ms threshold of QE5.
expectations.evidence: with_skill p95 3.92 ms; baseline p95 5.2 ms. Both against 500 ms.

expectations.text: Reports a measured memory figure and compares it with the 256 MB limit of QE6.
expectations.evidence: with_skill 28 MiB / 256 MiB; baseline peak 26.5 MiB / 256 MiB.

expectations.text: Commits the load-test script into the repo so it joins the regression suite.
expectations.evidence: with_skill: tests/acceptance/002-find-a-task/perf/search.js. Baseline: no perf artefact in the repo, the measurement is only described in the report.

expectations.text: Runs the 001 acceptance tests as a regression and reports the result.
expectations.evidence: 11 of 11 pass in both runs.

expectations.text: Gives a verdict that routes the design problem correctly (blocked on architecture, or changes requested with the gap written).
expectations.evidence: with_skill: 'Changes requested (F1 needs the architect first, gap G1)' plus the gap file. Baseline: 'Rejected – findings to fix' and no gap file, so the architect gets nothing to act on.

expectations.text: Adds black-box acceptance tests under tests/acceptance/002-find-a-task/.
expectations.evidence: search.test.js in both runs.

expectations.text: Changes no product code.
expectations.evidence: git diff against the seed tip is empty in both runs.

expectations.text: Asks the user no question in its final message.
expectations.evidence: Neither run asks anything.

expectations.text: Updates the existing docs/validation/002-due-dates.md and keeps round 1 readable.
expectations.evidence: Both updated the same file and moved F1-F3 into the Closed findings table with how each was closed.

expectations.text: Adds a round 2 and raises the round number.
expectations.evidence: Both set 'Round: 2'.

expectations.text: Closes F1 after re-running its own reproduction steps.
expectations.evidence: Both re-ran the X-Today steps and got dueState 'due-today'.

expectations.text: Withdraws F2 rather than reopening it, with reference to S6.3.
expectations.evidence: Both accept the implementer's quote and withdraw it as the validator's own preference.

expectations.text: Closes F3.
expectations.evidence: Both verified the order fix with the round-1 steps.

expectations.text: Opens a new finding with a fresh ID for the breakage the F3 fix introduced.
expectations.evidence: Both opened F4.

expectations.text: Identifies the breakage as done tasks no longer sorted below open ones (001 S3.2).
expectations.evidence: Both name the rewritten comparator in src/store.js and 001 S3.2.

expectations.text: Runs the complete validation again, not only the three findings.
expectations.evidence: Both produced a full coverage table plus regression.

expectations.text: Runs both acceptance suites and reports the numbers.
expectations.evidence: with_skill: 001 10/11, 002 15/16. Baseline: 23 passed and 2 failed across both suites, naming the two.

expectations.text: Gives the verdict 'Changes requested'.
expectations.evidence: Both.

expectations.text: Changes no product code.
expectations.evidence: git diff against the seed tip is empty in both runs.

expectations.text: Asks the user no question in its final message.
expectations.evidence: Neither run asks anything.

expectations.text: Does not record a non-functional requirement as passed when it actually fails.
expectations.evidence: Reported QE7 as 'one line of inputs, one button' and QE1 as fine. Measured afterwards in a browser at 375x812 on this exact build: the add form is two rows and 94 px high, the page scrolls sideways (scrollWidth 387 vs 375), the tick-off checkbox is squashed to 13x24 px on dated rows and the Delete button ends at 385-387 px, outside the viewport. Added after iteration 1 once the build was measured independently.
